content: Krais madaa kone rulalia aare ora redepo ne aa piralia

Nina ame baaninu-ya, neme waru agaa lo kiritua lagulalo pi: Nimiri Aa Mudumi raana omape kone waru ginalo lalo. Neme agaa meda nimi piri-para wala o taapere nimi raba meapena ya-pulu ni kedaame naomalo.
Nimimiri waea pape aanu waru adalepape. Nimu ora wae yana-rupa pirua nimina yogane kepetalo peme-ga waru adalepape.

Niaame padanere ora yogane kadolape kone rado meda waru ima. Goa pua niaame Gote-na Holi Spirit-miri Gote-na bi minasaawa Yesu Krais raapu pirua raaname omoaema. Goa pua niaame yogane madaa kone naima. Go yaemere niaa mada naraba mealia.
Gore neme go yogane madaa i konenu waru ade-pulu agaa adaapu mada lalo. Gore aa medaloma nimu raba minalo yogane madaa kone sua kepetalo pemere neme nimuna kone page mada maoge yalua.

Pagalepa. Oro meda pa popenaloa nina yogane kepeasimi. Niri Israel aa pirua amame Benjamin-na ruru madisa. Niri akuanuna Hibru agaa to. Nemere Juda onaanuna rekena agaa waru pagoa Farisi aa page pirisu.
Goa pisu rabu neme pu maoyaawa Gote-na onaanu kedaa waru mea kasude. Gore neme rekena agaa pagoa go pora kurua go agaa ogesi-daa nagimoa pisu.
Yapare abia neme Krais madaa kone rulaawa apo pisude yae rayore ora epe yoto meape yae-daa nato. Dia, go yae rayore ora etapape yaenu lalo.

Neme apo abana kone agu-para nalalo. Dia, pare nina Aa Mudu Yesu Krais nipuna kone niminaaluame pi. Goa pea-ga niminaae kone madaare apo abana kone-para oyae rayo etapainawa. Neme Yesuna kone mua neme kone rado meda rayore aba gimoa rubisu. Neme Krais padane raapu polalo pi-pulu oyae medalomare ora wae eta ebo-rupa naaku-para mea rubalua.

Goa palua rabu ni nipu raapu ora padane piralua. Goa pea-ga niri nina bipa rekena agaa kuralua-daare epe redepo ne kone mada namealua. Dia, pare neme Yesu Krais madaa kone rulayo-pulu nina redepo ne kone muaayo. Go redepo ne konere Gote-me gea-pulu go koneme puri mapalaaya.
Abiare neme Krais nipu wala rekesa-daa makualaminalo pe. Go page nipumi pisa-rupa kedaa rua nipuna omesade kone mogeatalo pi.
Neme goa paluare ni page matmat-para wala rekalua kone sua ado piralua.
Pol nipu robo-para aloma pisa
Neme Yesuna kone rayo aba meawade kone sua nalalo. Dia, neme kone rayo namuaayo pare neme mulalo pi. Goa pe rabu Yesu Krais-me abade ni misa-rupare neme nipuna kone mulalo pi.
Nina ame baaninu-ya, neme go konere abi namu kirite. Dia, pare abiare neme ora kone padane gupa suaayo: Neme abade yaenuri kone rugulaawa orope epe yaenu mulalo kogono puri paloa pe.
Goa pua Gote-na kone ni aipapulu aloma epe-rupa puare epe yoto mulalo pi. Go yotore Gote-me Yesu Krais lakenaloa nipumi ni so yaa-para piranolo mayaatea.
Gore niaa Krais-na kone ora mema-ga kone rayo mogeamina. Yapare nimi medaloma kone rado saapimiri Gote-me go kone page mada maredepo yaalia.
Goa pea-ga niaame Krais raapu kone aba meamade-rupare gore waru ripinaabawa pora pamuamina.
Amenu, nimimiri nina kone ratalimina. Niaame pora epe-rupa ratalima-daare onaa medaloma go pora ratalimi page waru adalepape.
Oro yaalo rana adaapu nimi laguaayo pare abia page wala apo lagialo rabu re lalo: Gore onaa adaapumi Gote-na pora madaa kone narulaawa Krais-na repena polopea madaa iaa aulaeme.

Go onaanuri nimumi Gote madaa kone narulaeme pare yogane mada meape yae kone rulaeme. Nimumi kone rado suare yala pi yae madaare raaname omeme. Nimuna su amaa yaenu padane madaa puri pabea kone suaeme. Goa pea-pulu nimu ora wae naaku-para polalo pimi.
Goa peme pare niaare yaa-para pirape onaanu yaade. Niaamere Aa Mudu Yesu Krais nipumi so yaa-para gimoa epaliade yapi di waru ado piramina.
Go rabu nipumi go niaana omape yoganere wala nipuna epe yogane-rupa maawa puri gialia. Go puri nipu padaneme oyae rayo surubalia.
